_note: Playable characters. You pick one before the game; the bots get the others. 'weapon' is what your Attack card is called (same rules: -1 HP); 'attack' and 'finisher' are the move names shown when it hits / when it knocks someone out. 'style' picks the animation in scripts/attack_fx.gd; 'icon' is assets/icons/<icon>.png.
